description: Location-code vocabulary for sijoituspaikka.sijoituspaikan_nimi — built from REAL data (discovery query, 76 distinct values in test slice). The codes follow a structured prefix system. Greenhouse cell-level mapping to floor-plan cells still needs confirmation from the head gardener — placeholders marked TODO.

G-H*.doc: Maps to greenhouse zones. The letter after G-H likely matches the floor plan's lettered areas. CONFIRM with head gardener which floor-plan cell each one is.

T-x.y.z.doc: Hierarchical plot system: T-<field>.<row>.<position>. Outdoor cultivation plots.

X-*.doc: X-TUTK. = tutkimus (research). Others TBD with gardener.

K-n.doc: TBD — possibly kenttä (field) or kasvualue numbering.

Z-SV.meaning: Largest single location in test data (38 rows)
Z-SV.doc: TBD with gardener — possibly seed storage (siemenvarasto)?

Y-O / H-O / M-L.doc: H-O appears in SIIRTO records ('SIIRTO H-O:STA K-19'). TBD.

n/ m.doc: Classic bed/position numbering for outdoor beds. '11/a', '11/B' = sub-positions.

freeform.doc: Free text with legacy latin1 mangling. AULA = the entrance hall between greenhouses. Agent must handle these gracefully — fall back to showing the raw string.

asterisk_suffix.doc: Some locations carry condition stars inline: '10/***', '14/*', 'O5/ 16*', 'L2:61-62/ 10**'. The stars after the slash are CONDITION ratings embedded in the location field by legacy habit. Strip them when parsing location; they are not part of the location code.

gardener_questions: Which G-H* codes map to Romeo cells A1-A17 and B1-B6?
Is the letter in G-Hx the bed letter on the floor plan?

fallback.doc: When a DB code has no mapping, show the raw code + section. Never block on missing mapping.
fallback.text_template_en: This plant is at location '{db_code}'{section_suffix}. Ask a gardener if you can't find it.
